# Commands Encyclopedia

## NPM Scripts

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `npm run dev` | Dev server |
| `npm run build` | Production build |
| `npm run lint` | ESLint check |
| `npm run test` | Unit tests |
| `npm run test:e2e` | E2E tests |
| `npm run qa` | Full QA pipeline |
| `npm run desktop` | Electron dev |
| `npm run desktop:pack` | Package .exe |

## Git Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `git status` | Check changes |
| `git add . && git commit -m ""` | Commit |
| `git push` | Push to remote |
| `git stash` | Temporarily save |
| `git checkout -b` | Create branch |

## Obsidian Commands

| Hotkey | Action |
|--------|--------|
| Ctrl+P | Quick switch |
| Ctrl+Shift+F | Search in files |
| Ctrl+Shift+S | Quick save |
| Ctrl+, | Settings |

## VSCode

| Hotkey | Action |
|--------|--------|
| Ctrl+Shift+P | Command palette |
| F5 | Debug |
| Ctrl+Shift+B | Build |
| Ctrl+\` | Terminal |

## Game Hotkeys

| Key | Action |
|--------|--------|
| WASD | Move |
| Space | Interact/Attack |
| E | Inventory |
| Q | Quests |
| Tab | Map |
| Esc | Menu |
| 1-5 | Skills |
| F | Attack |
